explanation: He was born Markus Rothkowitz in 1903 in Dvinsk, then in the Russian Empire, a city Latvians call Daugavpils. He moved to the United States in 1913.

claims.text: Mark Rothko was born in 1903 in Dvinsk, present-day Daugavpils in Latvia.
Rothko was not born in the United States, Germany or Poland.
Rothko's birth name was Markus Rothkowitz.
When Rothko was born, Dvinsk was part of the Russian Empire.
Rothko moved to the United States in 1913.
